CustomField.description: Inputs the envelope's outstanding action items still owe, as counted by the wizard (c/envelopeFormSchema) on its last save. Internal app state written only by WizardEnvelopeStateService.saveEnvelopeState and read by the envelope list's Missing Items column; never entered by hand. Null means no save has computed it yet, which the list renders as 0.
CustomField.label: Missing Items Count
